cover.sub: THE BEST STORIES ARE OFF THE MAIN PATH

items.title: SKUNK APE
cards: Read the Skunk Ape flyers around Key Lento and call Kirk.
A howl in the Grassrivers, a deer carcass, a strange totem.

items.title: KYLE, THE FARMER
cards: Kyle McKittrick, a Frogswater farmer with a broken arm, needs a crop-dusting pilot.
Keep helping him. It gets weird.

items.title: THE NO FLUSHERS
cards: Heard them on the radio? Check the notice board in Port Gellhorn.
It leads to Dr. Merle in a waffle restaurant in Vice City.

items.title: DODO RISING
cards: An animal rights group protesting a chimp sanctuary near Vice City International Airport.

items.title: YAGO, THE STREET RACER
cards: The races look simple, but his story has real depth and a memorable ending (IGN).

items.title: PAPA AUDACITY
cards: A stuntman near Ocean Beach launching his own crypto: Audacity Coin.
It's funny and it opens up the stunt challenges.

items.title: ANDY AND CELLERICA
cards: Lucia's friend Andy comes back later, now living in Belville.
Deliveries for a very odd business called Cellerica.

end.sub: Drop the number in the comments
